shortDescription: MONTREAL, Nov. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Knight Therapeutics Inc. TSX:GUD (“Knight” or “the Company”) is pleased to announce it has been named to the 2026 Report on Business magazine ranking of Quebec’s Top Growing Companies at No. 40, with three-year revenue growth of 53%.Quebec’s Top Growing C…

children: (“Knight” or “the Company”) is pleased to announce it has been named to the 2026
ranking of Quebec’s Top Growing Companies at No. 40, with three-year revenue growth of 53%.
Quebec’s Top Growing Companies is an editorial ranking launched in 2026 within
’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies portfolio, recognizing industry leaders in select provinces.

“We are honored to be named one of Quebec’s Top Growing Companies, a recognition that is especially meaningful for a company founded in Montreal,” said Samira Sakhia, President and CEO of Knight. “Since 2014, we have built a strong platform across Canada and Latin America and have become a growing, profitable and cash-generating business. Our 53% three-year revenue growth reflects the stellar performance of our business development team adding more products to our pipeline and portfolio, as well as the focused execution by our regulatory, quality, medical and commercial teams in getting these products approved, launched, reimbursed and prescribed. With more than 50 product launches still ahead, we look forward to bringing new treatment options to patients across Canada and Latin America.”
The full list of 2026 winners, along with editorial coverage, is published online on The Globe and Mail

“While our annual ranking of Canada’s Top Growing Companies celebrates the innovation and resilience of businesses nationwide, this ranking takes a specifically regional lens – bringing new energy, focus, and perspective to the diverse range of businesses and success stories across the country. We’re excited to showcase what success looks like from coast to coast,” says Garth Thomas, Managing Director of The Globe and Mail, Business and Financial Products.

The Globe and Mail is Canada’s foremost news media company, leading the national discussion and causing policy change through brave and independent journalism since 1844. With our award-winning coverage of business, politics and national affairs, The Globe and Mail newspaper reaches 6.1 million readers every week in our print or digital formats, and Report on Business magazine reaches 2.7 million readers in print and digital every issue. Our investment in innovative data science means that as the world continues to change, so does The Globe. The Globe and Mail is owned by Woodbridge, the investment arm of the Thomson family.

Knight Therapeutics Inc., headquartered in Montreal, Canada, is a pharmaceutical company focused on acquiring, in-licensing and commercializing pharmaceutical products for Canada and Latin America. Knight’s Latin American subsidiaries operate under United Medical, Biotoscana Farma and Laboratorio LKM. Knight Therapeutics Inc.’s shares trade on the TSX under the symbol GUD.
